identifier_contract.key_status: public, fixed, test-only; not for field collection
identifier_contract.input_kind: fully synthetic scenario role labels; not MAC addresses

definitions.Location: one strongest sensor per retained identifier and UTC window; ties use sensor_name ascending
definitions.Count: distinct retained identifiers after Location assignment
definitions.Track: ordered Location rows split by inactivity gap; OD requires at least two windows and different endpoints
definitions.Revisits: distinct Asia/Seoul calendar dates among qualifying trajectories; observed identifier frequency, not people
definitions.Activities: anchor-distance clusters split by continuity gap; stay requires minimum episode duration
